question: How many paying subscribers does Spotify have in India?
idealClarificationQuestions: Premium individual + Premium Family + Duo + Student plans, all included? Yes.
Free users with ads excluded? Yes — only paying.
Include shared family subs as 1 or as multiple? Count by paying account holder.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Top-down: total music streaming users in India → Spotify market share → free vs paid conversion ratio.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Total music streaming users in India (across Spotify, JioSaavn, Gaana, YT Music, Apple Music, Wynk): ~250M MAU.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Spotify market share in India: ~22-25% (JioSaavn leads in absolute users via Jio bundling, but Spotify leads in engagement).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Indian conversion rate to paid (very low — free tier is generous, price-sensitive market): ~6-8% (vs 45% globally).

benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~22-25% (JioSaavn leads in absolute users via Jio bundling, but Spotify leads in engagement).
